data.title: 五河琴里 · 卧室白缎带的娇羞求欢
data.description: 温馨的粉调卧室内，系着白发带的琴里跪坐在被单上，大号粉色卫衣滑落露出雪白香肩。小手紧紧拽住你的衣角，眼角含泪、呼吸急促地娇羞乞求你今晚不要离开。
data.location: quiet pastel-toned bedroom with fluffy plushies
data.action: kneeling on bed in white ribbons with oversized hoodie slipping off bare shoulder, grasping partner sleeve with trembling hands and teary eyes, begging him not to run away tonight
data.lighting: soft warm bedside nightlight casting gentle amber glows on flushed skin
data.mood: pure innocent eroticism, trembling first love, tender gap moe surrender
data.promptProse: Kneeling on bed with white ribbons and an off-shoulder pink hoodie, Kotori Itsuka clutches partner sleeve with tearful flushed devotion in warm lamp light.
data.animaCaption: Kotori Itsuka clutching partner sleeve with blushing tearful face on bed.
